name: Command Palette Workflow
description: Verifies Cmd+K palette: opening, navigation actions, process search, selection, and dismissal paths.

planSteps.description: Assert the palette opens with navigation actions and the top processes
Type a process name or PID
Assert matching processes appear with CPU% and PID
Assert the palette closes, the Processes tab opens, and that process is selected
Click a navigation action (e.g. Go to Users & Sessions)
Assert the palette closes and the target tab opens
Reopen the palette and press ESC
Assert the palette closes (ESC is now wired via onExitCommand)
